ios.desc:
BUDGT tells you exactly how much you can spend each day. No complicated spreadsheets, no bank syncing — just a simple daily number that keeps your finances on track.

HOW IT WORKS
Your monthly budget is divided by the remaining days in the month. Spend less today, and tomorrow's budget grows. Overspend, and it shrinks. Simple math that works.

DAILY BUDGET (DAY VIEW)
• See your daily spending limit at a glance
• Color-coded feedback: blue (good), yellow (careful), orange (slow down), red (stop)
• Log expenses in seconds
• Unspent money rolls over to tomorrow

MONTHLY OVERVIEW (MONTH VIEW)
• Track your total monthly spending
• See spending by category in a beautiful pie chart
• Month-end projection shows where you're heading
• Adjust course before it's too late

BUDGET SETUP
• Set up recurring income and expenses once
• Rent, utilities, subscriptions — automatically deducted
• Your daily budget reflects only what you can actually spend

SMART FEATURES
• Savings Mode: Set a savings goal and your daily budget adjusts automatically
• Travel Mode: Enter expenses in foreign currencies with your own exchange rate
• Day Weight: Allocate more budget to weekends or specific days
• Reminders: Gentle nudges to log your spending
• Categories: Organize spending with custom categories
• Notes & Geotagging: Remember what and where you spent

100% PRIVATE
• All data stays on your device
• No cloud sync, no accounts, no tracking
• Works completely offline
• Your finances are nobody's business

SECURITY
• Face ID protection
• PIN code lock option
• Export data as CSV anytime

Since 2013, BUDGT has helped people take control of their daily spending. No gimmicks, no complexity — just a clear answer to "what can I spend today?"

Start your free trial and see the difference a daily budget makes.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I rebuilt my 13-year-old budgeting app from scratch in Flutter

quotes.text:
I built BUDGT in 2013 as a broke student who needed one answer: "how much can I spend today without going broke this month?" It divides your monthly budget into a daily allowance — one number, updated in real time as you log expenses.

13 years and thousands of users later, I rebuilt the whole thing from scratch. The original Objective-C app couldn't support what users were asking for (analytics, category budgets), so I moved to Flutter and rewrote every screen.

What's different:
- Full redesign with a modern UI
- Analytics: spending pace, month-over-month, day-of-week patterns, top expenses
- Category targets: set limits per category, not just an overall budget
- Category drill-down: see exactly where money goes within each category

What hasn't changed:
- 100% offline. No account, no cloud, no bank connection, no tracking.
- All data stays on the device. I literally cannot see your data.
- Same daily budget concept — one number, color-coded feedback.

The hardest part was migrating existing users' Core Data (SQLite) to the new Drift database without losing any records. Existing users get the update automatically and see a migration flow that moves their entire history.

Happy to discuss the technical side (Flutter architecture, Core Data migration, App Store continuity with a full rewrite) or the product side.

iOS only: https://apps.apple.com/app/id580812126
